_comment: Base (fallback) language file for mova-context i18n. Every key that exists here MUST exist - the i18n package falls back to this file (English) whenever the active language is missing a key or cannot be read (see src/i18n/i18n.go's Load/T).

flags.repo: Local path or remote git URL to analyze
flags.export: Export format: pdf or md (default: md)
flags.task: Task or query used to rank file relevance (BM25)
flags.force: Overwrite an existing target directory instead of skipping the clone

subcommands.context_trace: Analyze context composition, token budget, and security before calling an LLM
subcommands.budget: Estimate token budget and cost for a project

messages.confirm_project_json: Generate a 'project.json' file with the detected suggestions? [Y/n]:
messages.enter_target_dir: Enter target directory path to save the cloned repository:
messages.target_dir_required: A target directory path is required.
messages.dir_not_empty_skip_clone: Target directory already has content - writing only project.json there (no re-clone attempted). Pass --force to overwrite it and clone fresh instead.

help.context_trace_short: Analyze a repository's context, security, and cost before sending it to an LLM
help.context_trace_example: mova context-trace --repo https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi --task "fix login bug" --export pdf
help.chat_short: Start a conversation with the configured model

reports.would_sanitize: Would sanitize (audit mode - no file was rewritten)
reports.estimated_cost: Estimated cost (for the {{count}} tokens that would actually be sent - not the whole repository)
reports.task_not_applied: Task-specific ranking: NOT APPLIED - no task or query intent was provided.
reports.safe_to_send_now: Safe to send RIGHT NOW: {{tokens}} tok ({{pct}} reduction)
reports.files_with_indicator: Files with an indicator: {{total}} = would_sanitize {{would_sanitize}} + blocked {{blocked}} + detected-but-allowed {{detected}}
reports.cost_basis_note: Calculated over the **{{tokens}} final sendable tokens** (ALLOWED + SANITIZED in discovery mode, or the assembled Agents/Skills/Prompt/Focus/Memory context in a `project.json` run) — never over the whole scanned repository. All costs are estimates in **USD**, based on the prices configured in `config/prices.json`. Labeled explicitly as **Theoretical / Estimated Input Cost** - they exclude output tokens, tool calls, caching, and other provider-specific charges.
reports.audit_mode_note: Executed in Audit Mode: this run only analyzed the repository. No file was modified, sanitized, or redacted on disk.
reports.final_context_box: Safe as-is: {{safe}} tok - Would sanitize: {{would_sanitize}} tok - Transformed: 0 tok
reports.sendable_breakdown_title: SENDABLE CONTEXT BREAKDOWN (audit mode - nothing written to disk):
reports.sendable_after_sanitization: Sendable AFTER sanitization is applied: {{tokens}} tok ({{pct}} reduction)
reports.generated_by_footer: Generated by mova context-trace - one engine, four doors (CLI, Chat, MCP, HTTP)

diagrams.pii_masking_detail: PII Masking: {{masked}}/{{scanned}} token(s) pseudonymized (privacy, not a token reducer)
diagrams.budget_focus_detail: Budget & Focus: {{without}} tok (whole repo) -> {{with}} tok (focused), {{pct}}% narrower
diagrams.firewall_reduction_detail: Before Governance: {{before}} tok -> After: {{after}} tok ({{pct}}% reduction)
diagrams.no_report_data: No report data available yet — run "mova budget {{project}}" first.

mcp.tool_context_trace_description: Analyzes context composition, token budget, Context Governance status, and estimated cost before calling an LLM.
mcp.tool_chat_description: Sends a message to the configured chat model and returns its reply.
mcp.auto_apply_detected: [Auto-Apply] Confirmation detected - applying previous proposal directly.

chat.welcome: Mova Chat ready. Type your message, or /help for commands.

file_changes.description: Applies file changes (create, modify, or delete) on one or multiple files in the workspace.
file_changes.prompt_confirm_header: Mova Context detected proposed changes for the following files:
file_changes.options_menu:
How would you like to proceed with these changes?

  [1..N] Apply to specific indices only (e.g., 1, 1,3)
